name: @estebanforge/pi-peer-review
description: Adversarial peer review for Pi: /peer-review diff-reviews every change since the last check under an adversarial frame (task, executor's claim, real diffs, claim audit) and passes BLOCKER/RISK findings to the model as untrusted claims. Also ships the failure-loop unblock gate (/unblock, /advice) and a pre-publish review boundary. No model-facing tool: the triggers are deterministic, so the session cannot talk itself out of them.
